combat.wins.description: Fights the player has won in this playthrough. Only the registry writes it, when a fight ends.

combat.losses.description: Fights the player has lost in this playthrough. A lost fight is a death: the whole party falls. Only the registry writes it.

example.has_key.description: The player is carrying the stranger's key. Set outside dialogue, when the key is picked up.

example.promised_help.description: The player promised to look for the key and has not handed it back yet. Refusing withdraws the promise.

example.times_met.description: How many times the first meeting has been completed in this playthrough.

example.met_before.description: The stranger was met in some playthrough. Survives loading an earlier save.

world.fantasy_closed.description: The Fantasy world cannot be reached tonight, so the Nightmare world cannot either. Read by world_access.json.

world.nightmare_closed.description: The Nightmare world cannot be reached tonight, even after the Fantasy world. Read by world_access.json.
